incidents.name: Inuko Finance bond LP spot-price manipulation
incidents.notes: The Inuko bond contract valued the INUKO/USDT LP tokens deposited through buyBond() from the pair's live reserves, so a flash loan inflated that valuation and the bond later paid out far more than the LP was worth.

sources.ref: onchain review: bond 0x09beDDae85a9b5Ada57a5bd7979bb7b3dd08B538 created 2022-10-13T15:11:37Z by 0x85f6be9460291e86e0fb49b07d0a83cc5f7206cd, unrelated to attack sender 0xb12011c14e087766f30f4569ccaf735ec2182165; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. The bond was bought at block 22169170 and claimed in this transaction; loss verified onchain: 71,238.51 USDT left the INUKO/USDT pair and 64,834.40 USDT reached the attacker. Boundary row: the bond behaved as coded and the attacker moved the LP price it read.
